people.name: Samuel
people.line: Prophet and last judge of Israel before the kings

translations.web: Samuel said, “Then what does this bleating of the sheep in my ears, and the lowing of the cattle which I hear mean?”
translations.bsb: But Samuel replied, “Then what is this bleating of sheep and lowing of cattle that I hear?”
translations.kjv: And Samuel said, What meaneth then this bleating of the sheep in mine ears, and the lowing of the oxen which I hear?
translations.asv: And Samuel said, What meaneth then this bleating of the sheep in mine ears, and the lowing of the oxen which I hear?
